Clerk
Office Hours
8:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.
Monday – Friday
Open through the lunch hour
Closed Weekends and Holidays
Mailing Address
PO Box 134
Clay Center, NE 68933
Location
111 W Fairfield St
Clay Center, NE 68933
Services & Links
Our office now accepts all major credit cards. The vendor we use charges a service fee of 2.49% for all transactions which we must charge back to the customer. The electronic check charge is $1.75.
Treasurer Office
Duties
Collect all revenues for the County
To bill and collect property taxes in the County
Title and register vehicles in the County (One Stop Shop)
Boat Registrations
Snowmobile Registrations
Issue the temporary drivers licenses, CDL’s, Learner permits, ID cards, School Permits, etc
Disburse collections to the proper political subdivisions
Telephone Numbers
Driver’s License Examiner (Every other Tuesday): 402-762-3082
(8:15-12:00 and 12:30-4:00)
Nebraska Department of Motor Vehicles: 402-471-3918
Nebraska State Treasurer: 402-471-2455
Heavy Vehicle Use Tax: 800-829-3676
Department of Transportation: 402-437-5521
DOT Numbers – Carrier Enforcement: 402-471-0105
Boating Division: 402-471-5579
Bureau of Vital Statistics: 402-471-2871
Informational Materials Available:
Specialty licenses plate applications
Handicapped parking permit applications
